journal.title: Opened: $1,000, trades only on Vamsi's direction
journal.body:
Start: $1,000 paper cash, Sat Oct 3. Default finish: the Mon Oct 5, 4:00 PM ET close, the same line as the other two books; Vamsi can extend it.
Instruments: stocks, ETFs (leveraged and inverse included), listed options (regular session; buy at the ask, sell at the bid) and spot crypto (24/7). Cash account: no margin, no short selling, no naked option writing.
Process: Vamsi says where to look and how to trade. Each instruction is journaled with the trade it produced, and the stops and exits he sets are enforced at every routine run.

checks.label: Cash account, no margin
checks.detail: FINRA requires $2,000 of equity for margin, so at $1,000 there is no borrowing and no short selling. Bearish bets use puts or inverse ETFs.

checks.label: Stocks, ETFs, listed options, spot crypto
checks.detail: Options are bought (calls and puts), so the most a contract can lose is its premium. No naked option writing.

checks.label: No good-faith violations (T+1 settlement)
checks.detail: 0 violations. Stocks and options settle T+1; crypto settles instantly.

checks.label: Activity tracked in the open
checks.detail: 0 orders so far (0 today), 0 day trades. No pattern-day-trader limit in a cash account.

checks.label: Public information only
checks.detail: Trades act on published news and prices: no insider information, no coordinated pumping.

checks.label: No OFAC-restricted (NS-CMIC) securities
checks.detail: Applies to every US person and anyone physically in the US.
